reuse.why: There is no shared month-wide selection helper in this tree, and the change patches each of the six copies in place rather than extracting one, so nothing is reused but nothing existing is bypassed either.

duplication.why: The same '(? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))' clause and parameter are pasted into five identical SQL queries plus a sixth JS variant in copyPreviousMonth, extending the existing duplication instead of consolidating it.

placement.why: Changes sit in server/budget/actions.ts with the actions they affect, consistent with where the tree keeps this filtering.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing through the month-wide actions and one test.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule now has six copies to keep in sync, two forms (SQL vs JS), and the 'g.hidden = 0' LEFT JOIN subtlety is repeated each time.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared month-wide category selection to go around; each action already ran its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated clause is pasted verbatim into each query in server/budget/actions.ts, not disguised.
